items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Dave Dexter from Capitol Records... heard me... contacted me... wanted me to come up to the office here... he asked me had I ever recorded before... it all started from that.

ctx.x: Right. So he said, "The program is so loaded I don't know if you'll have a chance to do more than one tune." He said, "But anyway, we'll see. You may get a chance to do it." And I didn't have -- there was nobody there to play with me, to accompany me, you know, so he says, "Can you work by yourself?" And I said, "Yes, I'll have to." So I went on and did my little number. I did, "The One I love Belongs to Somebody Else," you know. So Dave Dexter from Capitol Records was at home with his wife, and she was pregnant…
